{{Quote|I..I can't hold on much longer...(gasp)|The guard after the Queen finishes in the machinery room|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''guard''' of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] was wounded during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. He was sent to retrieve reinforcements and weapons, but was wounded by a battle droid when the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]] led an [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|attack against]] the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]-occupied [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. At the time of his wounding he wore the [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Palace Guard]] uniform

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Queen [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] met this light-skinned guard when she was moving through the city to enter the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]]. She asked the guard how to open a security door, and the guard suggested she destroy the gate's power source in the machinery room. He then suggested she ask an [[Unidentified R5 unit (Theed)|astromech droid]]. The astromech opened the door to the machinery room for her so Amidala could continue her mission.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I must be going.|What the player can say to ignore the guard|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)" />}}
This guard appears in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|adaptation]] of the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Episode I'']] movie. The player, taking the role of Amidala, may meet this guard during the course of the game's ninth mission. The player can talk to the guard using several dialogue options. The guard suggests the astromech droid if the player had told the droid to stay in its place back in the sixth mission. If the player had not, the guard gives Amidala a red key to open a separate security door. This article assumes that the player chose a specific dialogue choice and that the astromech droid was available. In the game's credits, [[Greg Burson]] is listed as voicing "Injured Soldier #1," while [[Nick Jameson]] is listed as voicing "Injured Soldier #2," although it is not clear who voices this individual character. The guard and [[Unidentified wounded Naboo guard 1|another guard]] have an entry in the characters overview in the start of the game's [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]].
